decisions.reason: The personal purchase fact supports consumer status.
The service record and shutdown reports support a goods defect.
The alleged failure in after-sales handling is a plausible service deficiency.
The forum provision matches the value and consumer forum context.
The provision supports the complaint route.
The requested replacement and alternative remedies fit the relief provision.
The two-year limitation rule is relevant to the dates supplied.
The paid consideration is below the District threshold.
No evidence presently proves a deceptive promotional practice.
